title: Bounded multi-field TABLECONTENT reference grids
mode: P5 bounded implementation and generated ASCII/Binary source/output controls

scope.sourceProfile: Two simple childless FIELD objects with string cached values; a 2x2 TABLECONTENT grid carries six direct references, including both distinct targets and repeated references within one cell with a string scalar between them.
scope.handleRemapping: Source FIELD and TABLECONTENT handles are remapped; every emitted type-2 reference is checked against its corresponding emitted FIELD identity.
scope.claimBoundary: Bounded TABLECONTENT serializer and source-bound DXF replay transport only; no FIELD evaluation, FIELDLIST/child graph, DWG output, native TABLE rendering, or support claim.

implementation.summary: The adapter now admits a bounded set of distinct childless string-result FIELD objects, checks aggregate typed limits and raw/typed source pairing, requires every FIELD target to be referenced, and validates multi-reference cell order. TABLECONTENT references in rectangular grids can target multiple FIELD objects and repeat within a cell; emitted target closure is checked against one prebuilt unique source-handle set. The legacy 1x1 path remains limited to one reference with its existing optional string scalar.
implementation.testDrawings: Generated at runtime in scratch storage; no persistent DWG/DXF fixture was added.

controls.rawTypedImportPairing: Both imported FIELD records retain their identities, NOD owner, raw record profile and type-2 source references.
controls.wireProof: ASCII/Binary physical output contains both remapped FIELD records before TABLECONTENT and the six group-340 targets in exact cell/content order.
controls.readback: Fresh typed readback preserves both FIELD expressions/cached values, the rectangular grid, and all remapped reference order.
controls.failureAndRetry: An absent target is refused with destination sentinel preserved and caller model unchanged; restoring the target succeeds through the same adapter. Imported source identity mutation is refused, then corrected source replays successfully.

results.sourceReplaySelector: PASS; includes ASCII/Binary imported FIELD source pairing, remapped replay, refusal and corrected retry.

limitations: The accepted FIELD body remains the selected simple childless AcExpr/string cached-value profile.
FIELDLIST membership, child/object dependency graphs, non-string cached values, richer per-cell scalar combinations, and standalone 1x1 multiple-reference composition remain unqualified.
No field expression evaluation, native TABLE rendering, DWG output, ABI/platform/consumer qualification, or support claim is established.

planImpact.completedScopeRemovedFromQueue: More-than-two reference transport, multiple simple FIELD objects, and repeated FIELD references within one rectangular-grid cell.
planImpact.remainingP5Scope: FIELDLIST/child graphs, additional FIELD body/source/version profiles, standalone 1x1 multi-reference composition, other linked-cell payloads, and independent TABLE semantic/rendering evidence remain open.
